old_problem: The proprietary NVLink bandwidth run lacked a frozen GPU/NVSwitch directed graph, transfer shape, per-path raw measurement semantics, signed path-class floors, allowable error deltas and recovery; an aggregate harness PASS could hide a missing or degraded link.
disposition_reason: The row unambiguously requests NVLink bandwidth and sensor coverage. ED-03 permits topology, workload and performance floors as project configuration; ED-15 keeps the execution gate closed until numeric path-class oracles are signed, and ED-19 preserves each directed path rather than collapsing coverage.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row377 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek fields, GPT V2/history2970 and the unique V004 variant.
Distinguished NVLink fabric paths from the PCIe bandwidth case and required every expected directed GPU/NVSwitch edge to retain its own identity.
Retained the source 20-minute allocation, every NVQual subtest, GPU sensor check and post-run fabric recovery.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row378 and verified its manifest identity; no NVQual or DUT action ran.

test_case.purpose: Measure every approved directed GPU/NVSwitch NVLink path with the pinned NVQual workload and prove each path class meets its signed bandwidth and error limits without topology, GPU or platform-health degradation.
required_package: Licensed NVQual provenance/version/checksum and compatible driver/Fabric Manager stack
Pinned NVLink bandwidth wrapper/hash and complete subtest manifest
GPU UUID/BDF/slot, NVSwitch and directed link/port graph with expected active/absent states
Transfer direction, size, iterations, concurrency, warmup, sampling and 20-minute duration
Per-path-class bandwidth floors/tolerance, raw measurement formula/units and allowed link-error deltas
Workload drain, thermal/power/PSU/OOB hard stops, cooldown and fabric recovery
test_case.test_command: After artifact, directed graph, transfer profile, thresholds and safety approval, preserve pre-run topology/link/error and platform telemetry; run the pinned complete NVLink bandwidth suite once for the source 20-minute allocation, retain raw samples for every required direction/path and all subtests, then verify links, errors, GPUs and services return to their approved state.
test_case.expected_result: Every required directed path is present and produces complete valid raw measurements whose approved statistic meets its path-class floor/tolerance; every NVQual subtest passes; link state/width/speed and error counters remain within signed rules; no disqualifying XID, fabric, thermal, power or platform event occurs; final topology and services are healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the immutable graph, complete raw direction/path measurements, signed numeric floors/error rules, all subtests and synchronized health evidence. Aggregate harness PASS, a counter snapshot, missing path or result without an approved threshold cannot pass.
safety_gate: Explicit fabric/performance approval, idle workload drain and independent OOB access
Freeze GPU UUID-to-slot and directed GPU/NVSwitch link identities before saturation
Preserve logs and monitor topology, link errors, XID, thermal, power, fan and PSU state
Abort on missing/degraded/retrained link, new disqualifying error, thermal/power excursion or lost reachability; no retry
expected_evidence: Artifact/license/checksum, stack compatibility, wrapper hash and subtest manifest
GPU/NVSwitch directed topology with pre/post link states, widths/speeds and error counters
Transfer profile and complete raw path-attributed bandwidth samples/units
Per-path-class statistic/floor/tolerance and error-delta calculations plus every subtest result
Synchronized XID/fabric/thermal/power/fan/PSU/BMC evidence and final restored topology/services
test_case.recovery: On path degradation, error or safety event, terminate load without link reset or retry, preserve first-fault output and independent telemetry, cool down, isolate the affected GPU/link/switch path and use only the approved Fabric Manager/platform recovery sequence before any future run.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure, Script and Criteria consistently target NVLink bandwidth; topology and numeric path-class values are missing project bindings, not conflicting source requirements.

blocked.reason: The fabric purpose, measurement structure, evidence and recovery are review-complete; exact licensed artifact, graph, transfer profile and thresholds are execution prerequisites.
